extraction_notes: Target row confirmed on p. 2: 1SMA4740A (type code 740A): VZ min 9.50 / nom 10 / max 10.5 V at IZT = 25 mA; ZZT max 7.0 ohm at IZT; IR 10 uA max at VR = 7 V; IZM = 95 mA.

Maximum zener impedance ZZT = 7.0 ohm at IZT = 25 mA (p. 2); the schema has no dedicated slot, recorded here. ZZK at IZK is NOT published, so zener knee sharpness (NBV) cannot be fitted from knee impedance.

Curves were extracted from the PDF's embedded vector paths (PyMuPDF get_drawings), with axes calibrated against the tick-label text positions; endpoints and bezier samples are exact path coordinates, not pixel estimates.
Fig.3 is captioned 'Typical Zener Breakdown Characteristics' but its axes are IF(A) vs VF(V); it is the forward characteristic and is extracted as such.

Fig.3 x-axis tick labels 0, 0.4, 0.6 ... 1.6 V are equally spaced, so the first division (0 to 0.4 V) is compressed; all digitized points lie at VF >= 0.637 V inside the uniformly spaced region, where calibration is unambiguous.
The Fig.3 point at VF = 1.4 V is an exact point on the final straight path segment (linear in VF vs log IF between 1.201 V / 1.49 A and 1.602 V / 5.96 A), not a bezier sample.

Fig.2 (ZZT vs IZT) publishes curves only for VZ = 25, 30, 65 and 91 V; there is no curve for the 10 V target, and interpolating between neighboring-voltage curves would invent data, so Fig.2 was not digitized.
Forward table evidence is a single maximum point (VF = 1.5 V at IF = 200 mA, p. 1); typical forward-fit points come from the series-wide Fig.3 curve.
Absolute maximum ratings (p. 1): PD = 1000 mW at Tc = 75 degC, RthJA = 250 degC/W, Tj and Tstg -55 to +150 degC. Package DO-214AC (SMA).
No capacitance and no reverse recovery time are published anywhere in the datasheet; those spec slots are null.
Fig.3 conditions are pulsed (300 us, 1% duty), so digitized currents above roughly 0.1 A exceed the DC-admissible IZM/PD limits and represent pulsed operation only.
